reviews.author: john doe
reviews.text: Today was the 3rd time I've come back to Danny's Muffler Shop. There is a good reason: This couple that runs it are true professionals and know their craft well. Always an easy transaction and satisfaction guaranteed. All the work I've done with them are on my antique classics work is second to none. Thank you both again.

reviews.author: Carter English
reviews.text: Brought my car in because it was loud under acceleration. They quickly diagnosed a rusted and separated exhaust flange and explained everything clearly. The repair was done in about 30 minutes, the weld work looks solid, and the price was very fair. Car is quiet again and drives perfectly. Honest, fast, and professional, highly recommend.

reviews.author: Andres Correa
reviews.text: Nicole was a pleasure to work with! She helped with the Dinan exhaust on my BMW M2 and ensured correct clearance between components, proper fitment, and that there were no leaks. I highly recommend Danny’s Muffler Shop for all your exhaust needs, even over most “specialty” shops.

reviews.author: dede labonte
reviews.text: I was visiting South Carolina from New York. Ran over a dead deer, knocked my muffler off I stopped at a garage down there and he sent me to Danny’s muffler. I explained what happened she looked at it gave me a price and said she’d fix it right then. Amazing service! amazing price! Thank you so much for your help.

reviews.author: Mike Johns
reviews.text: Took our car in because we thought the catalytic converter was bad. They suggested we start with the O2 sensors and they turned out to be corroded and they were able to put a camera in to check the catalytic converter and said it looked good. We dropped it off around 9am and picked it up two hours later.

reviews.author: Isabelle Mojica
reviews.text: I my muffler fell off and I needed it repaired before I went back to school. She was able to fit me in same day and completed my service in an hour for a GREAT price. They were so nice, explained everything, and even gave me a before and after. My car has been loud for years but was shocked when it was silent after. If I have anymore issues I’ll definitely be back and recommending.

reviews.author: Dan Wackerhagen
reviews.text: So I use Sunrise auto a couple doors down to service all my vehicles. They sent me over to Danny’s muffler when my catalytic converter was stolen off my truck. I know the place looks rough. If you go inside it still looks rough. But the people and the work were great. Super friendly. Super fast. The price was good too. A year or so later a weld on a bracket holding my muffler broke and I didn’t think twice. Swung in and showed the lady and she had it fixed and back out front in ten minutes. I think she felt bad charging me for it. I didn’t feel bad paying for it. I had to tie it up with a bungee cord and it was banging against the undercarriage and they fixed it immediately. The fast friendly service and end of that embarrassment…worth every penny of the low price.

reviews.author: Dave Zal
reviews.text: Nicole was great to work with. Friendly and good communication. Had a mid pipe installed on my BMW M4. Very reasonable price and happy with the work. Nothing fancy about the shop but don’t let that steer you away from doing business with them. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Vanessa Pozzato
reviews.text: I had my exhaust repaired & 2 O2 Sensors replaced a few weeks ago by Nicole. She is amazing & my car is running better than it has in a long time, plus she charged me less than she'd originally quoted me. I absolutely recommend Danny's!

reviews.author: Candice Hughey
reviews.text: Danny's Muffler Shop made my mustang sound so good, the owners are wonderful, very trustworthy, excellent customer service. I highly recommend Danny's Muffler Shop.

reviews.author: Engineered Fitness
reviews.text: Beyond great experience! Worked with Nicole. She did a really good job with communication. Got me in and done within a day and price was very reasonable. They always do great work. Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Aficionado
reviews.text: The staff here is very helpful and friendly. Their customer service is good and their prices are great. The only reason for taking off one star is that they don’t replace the catalytic converters that attach to Honda Pilots with an aluminum engine block. But they do excellent muffler and exhaust work.

reviews.author: Michel Fournelle (Micfou)
reviews.text: Outstanding service. Was able to get the parts needed for our vehicle unless than 24 hrs and then managed to save the expensive catalytic converter which saved us lots of money. Thank you for being honest. We will pass the good word for your business.

reviews.author: Christopher Textor
reviews.text: They charge me to put a new gasket on my exhaust, which they never did. They also charge me to fix the flex pipe, and I put the wrong flex pipe on my vehicle. They did not even tighten the three bolts to the exhaust pipe to the manifold. Don’t waste your time or money on these people.

reviews.author: DJ R
reviews.text: Broke a bolt off in my frame trying to install a hitch. Took it to Danny’s and they had it finished the following morning and installed the hitch for me! They had to go to Lowe’s and get extra drill bits. Nicole kept me up to date with what was happening. What was great was that they found another issue with a loose heat shield and quickly fixed it. Fair price, kind, informative and professional. Excellent job!

reviews.author: Brooke Buffamoyer
reviews.text: Took my Ford Mustang to them to do a muffler delete and I can’t speak enough positive things about the lady and her husband! They know their stuff and kept me informed the whole time! They are hands down amazing!!!! The lady asked me if I wanted to keep my mufflers in case I decided to ever put them back on and she called me on the phone to let me hear how it sounded to make sure I was completely satisfied with the sound. I dropped it off that morning and it was done before lunch. Keep up the awesome job guys!!

reviews.author: Stephen Richardson
reviews.text: Went in to have the exhaust in my 5.7 Hemi Jeep Grand Cherokee upgraded. I already had the new system and just needed it installed. The young lady I spoke with knew her stuff! She quoted the job, even asked for my approval lining up the exhaust tips before finishing. Top notch! Do NOT judge the shop based off experience. Nothing fancy which is probably why they are so cheap, but do an excellent job. A++++++ Thank you Danny's Muffler Shop!

reviews.author: Chris Gilmore
reviews.text: Courteous, friendly, professional, and honest. They got my work done super fast and showed me what all they recommended be done. Actually replaced something I didn't want to pay for and didn't charge me for the part. Very fair, affordable, and honest. Great experience.

reviews.author: Ricky Traynham
reviews.text: I checked out Danny's because it was a community business. My 01 Grand Cherokee didn't sound like usual so I stopped by and explained to the young lady at the desk. She came out and put her skills to work listening to the strange sound and then pulling it in the shop to confirm. A hole on the top of the muffler. I had to order my replacement Flowmaster 50 series muffler. Two days later when the muffler came, quick trip to the shop and 20 minutes later another happy customer. Great service from the front desk to the back shop. I will use this shop again for future exhaust mods or issues.

reviews.author: Kyle Sanford
reviews.text: These guys were great! I got a new catalytic converter installed in about an hour. Very reasonably priced, and the welds look fantastic. What gets me is that there was another vehicle in front of me and they said I was probably going to have to wait a while. I'll go back to these guys in the future for sure!

reviews.author: Robert Garton
reviews.text: Be wary on there hourly charge. I was told on the phone that they charge $65 an hour for labor if you provide your own parts. They had to make a slight modification to a part that I brought. Took like 5 minutes for the modification, the whole job took around an hour. Labor charge ended up costing $160! Customer service was good and work seems solid.

reviews.author: Scott Laroche Sr
reviews.text: From start to finish these folks stayed in touch with me. Never avoided my calls and sent me pics of the job as needed. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for good people to do a fantastic job.

reviews.author: Derek Manet
reviews.text: My parents came to visit from out of town and hit something on the highway on their way that ended up causing some damage under their car. After a quick online search for muffler shops, Danny’s came up. I called to ask if they were able to take a look and provide a quote. To my surprise, they said they could for no charge. When my parents arrived, we drove to Danny’s and dropped it off after he explained what happened on the road. The early assessment was a $20 repair but potentially more after further diagnosis. A few hours later, they called to let him know what the problem was and that they didn’t have the necessary parts to make the repair, so they would not charge him anything. They were honest and very helpful and we are very appreciative of this. If I ever have any car trouble in the future, they will be my first call.

reviews.author: Charlie Hubbard
reviews.text: They replaced a loose muffler in under an hour (and at a great rate). The same service at most repair sites would be 2 - 3 times what I paid. It looked and sounded great. Highly recommend this shop for anyone in the Upstate.

reviews.author: Karen Healy
reviews.text: Muffler damage from speed bump repaired. They ended up charging less than the estimate and the service was exceptional. Hard to find such an honest and qualified service. Would recommend to family and friends.

reviews.author: Dustin Doerr
reviews.text: Great shop. Had 3 cars ahead of mine at 3pm, and he stayed after hours to finish my dual exhaust Challenger. Car was quiet when i dropped it off, and when I picked it up it sounded like the Fast and the Furious lol. Friendly & Professional staff, good pricing.

reviews.author: Julia Riddle
reviews.text: We had our car straight piped from them and then came back and explained a popping that was going on and the lady suggested resignators and said it wouldn't take away the sound too much so we did that. The sound was almost gone. Then just to find out that the exhaust wasn't the problem, so we went back to another exhaust shop and when they lifted the car, the welds looked horrible!! Like horrible, horrible. So we also had what we could fix fixed and paid half of what Danny's charged. I am severely disappointed. Everyone had referred me to them and I am out 500 dollars to them for it to sound the same as when I originally came. Then paid 100 dollars to have it fixed. And also, it would help if one of the guys would talk to you.

reviews.author: Kittenxplosion
reviews.text: I had to use them once tofix an exhause issue and they were able to get it done quickly and correctly. I've lived/worked in this area for almsot 20 years and this shop has always been here, so I'd say that is a testament to their quality.

reviews.author: D Patterson
reviews.text: Great group of mechanics, years of knowledge and experience. Some of the best welding in the upstate as unbeatable prices! Chris and Nicole will go out of their way to help you!

reviews.author: Larry Bennefield
reviews.text: When i cranked my Honda Civic up this evening it sounded like I was running open headers. I immediately ran it up to Danny's and they put it up on lit, ascertained what the problem was, and in less that 30 min i was in and out on my way home. The staff were very friendly and the price was so reasonable. I would definitely recommend that if you have any type of exhaust problem or problems that you should take it to them!.

reviews.author: Mike Savage
reviews.text: The folks at Danny's provide quality work and service for an amazing price! I came to them with an idea of what I wanted to do and their idea was even better! Will definitely do business with Danny's again in the future!

reviews.author: Bion Everette
reviews.text: Not much on small talk. But who cares about that. High quality work and honest people. Recommend this place to everyone. Someone stole my converter and they fixed it thousands of dollars cheaper then the dealer. Way to go guys.

reviews.author: Rodney Trantham
reviews.text: I highly recommend this shop to all. The service was great and it was very affordable! The owner danny is a great guy he took me in without an appointment and had my muffler and pipe welded up within an hour.

reviews.author: Rene Allen
reviews.text: I found this muffler shop on my Nextdoor app they had great reviews & was a family owned business.. the young lady( forgot her name) said yes come in we will take a look@ it.. I got there they had it safely set up tent outside due to the pandemic.. she looked under it& said yup.. ur muffler may need to be replaced once he gets it on lift they’ll confirm.. with in a hour.. & under.. yes Under 100 bucks with labor included I was on the road again with a new muffler!!!great business, Excellent prices great staff

reviews.author: Austin Collins
reviews.text: Great people. Had a flow master 40 put on about a month ago. Sounds great. Put it up on a lift the other day to check my rearend and noticed how all the welds on my "new" muffler are the crappiest welds I've ever seen and now the left tip is hanging down lower than the right. On top of that the exhaust looks like a used one. Very disappointed considering I spent 340$ on this. Tried calling up a few times and no answer. Very disappointing.

reviews.author: Kevin Nelson
reviews.text: Flex pipe broke at pipe to muffler. They were able to cut out and weld in a new one right away, and the price was fair. Only was repaired yesterday, so will need to drive it a little bit to see how it holds up. UPDATE 2/28/22. Repair has held up well!

reviews.author: Saman Hassan
reviews.text: Best place to get exhaust work done in the greenville area. Honest, straightforward communication and excellent work always. Thank you!

reviews.author: Tony Crescibene
reviews.text: Nicole and Chris did an outstanding job of repairing an exhaust leak. Great customer service with very fair pricing! Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Timothy Healy
reviews.text: Super nice people. Honest estimate, quality work done on time. Absolutely recommend this place to everyone who needs muffler work done.

reviews.author: Henry Hague
reviews.text: Unbelievably helpful group. Looked at my truck immediately and worked to diagnose what I knew to be a serious issue. They got me on my way. No fuss

reviews.author: Charles Lake
reviews.text: Wow! Was quoted over 350 to fix my muffler. Here they charged be $50 and had it down in a couple of hours. OUTSTANDING!

reviews.author: Robert C
reviews.text: Very friendly staff! I would recommend this muffler shop to anyone who needs muffler work done. They did excellent work for us!!

reviews.author: dave linsenman
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about this shop. Price is right and they take care of your needs. Even when it is last minute.

reviews.author: Chad Rushing
reviews.text: Went in thinking my catalytic converter on my Subaru was bad and all it was a rattling heat shield. Saved me big $$$ all they charged was $25 for some tac welds.

reviews.author: Peter Heggie
reviews.text: If you need any type of exhaust work, it is the only place to go. They are friendly, honest and work very quickly.

reviews.author: EllA Glenn
reviews.text: These are honest people. The secretary is the best. I highly recommend this place for you automotive repair needs.

reviews.author: Forrest McPhail
reviews.text: I was very happy with how straightforward and no-nonsense the people here were. I would definitely go there again
